name: Kawagiri Hana
source:
She is a very gentle girl and can sometimes give the impression of being plain, but she has unexpected enthusiasm and proactivity in certain areas. When someone she likes shows interest in something, she tends to agree with them.

After entering school, she began to admire the protagonist for some reason. She has been classmates with Chinatsu since childhood and although their personalities are different, they get along well. She has been in the same class as Yū since her first year.

She loves books and is a little bit of a dreamer.
